text: Grammar reference: line shapes, indentation rules (LUMD0301/0302/0304/0305), page header (presets a4/us_letter/linkedin_ad/envelope_dl/custom, orientations, units px/mm/in/pt), node kinds (frame/group/autolayout containers; leaves), property catalogue (paint, stroke, text, spans, effects, slot image_policy), images (spliced), two ways to change an existing scene.
Presets are shortcuts only. Never fake a square ad as a square frame inside an A4 page — set the page size.
Child p()/s() values are authored in canonical layout points and are artboard- or parent-local. Do not use physical mm or renderer pixels for child coordinates.

Two ways to change an existing scene: 1. Continuation — append new nested element lines under an existing container (do not re-declare the page). 2. Modify line — #<ref> prop(...) edits an existing object in place.
note: Lists two ways and leaves out apply_structured_edit, which the follow-up routine makes the default.
